cloud.failure_mode: Saved tokens support local API after WAN loss. Initial/offline activation is unproven, excluded gateways cannot be unlocked here, and app-side token lifecycle/firmware update may still require vendor service.
cloud.vendor_service: TaHoma app/account is used for installation and Developer Mode activation/token generation; local API calls then remain on the gateway LAN.

cover_close.advanced_reason: Moves a real cover and can trap an obstruction. Watch the full travel path and monitor actual state; execId is not completion. This is future dedicated-handler behavior, not a current generic control.
cover_close.description: Documentary attended close command; a future advanced network-action handler must confirm identity and an unobstructed travel path.

cover_open.advanced_reason: Moves a real cover. Confirm the device, direction and clear travel path; keep stop available and monitor to completion. This is future dedicated-handler behavior, not a current generic control.
cover_open.description: Documentary attended open command; a future advanced network-action handler must confirm identity, direction and clearance before sending.

cover_stop.description: Documentary stop POST, deliberately non-advanced so a dedicated client need not place an extra confirmation before halting movement.

fetch_events.description: Documentary bearer event fetch, at most once per second; invalid-listener 400 requires re-registration and setup resync.

listener_id.description: Runtime id returned by register_listener, not an owner credential.

get_execution.description: Documentary bearer request for one current local execution by execId.

list_executions.description: Documentary bearer request for currently running local API action groups.

read_api_version.description: Documentary unauthenticated API version request after mDNS PIN match and Overkiz TLS validation; no Authorization header.

read_device_states.description: Documentary bearer request for one device's named State array; URL-encode device_url exactly once.

device_url.description: DeviceURL from setup/devices, URL-encoded for the path.

returns.description: Preserve the State's JSON type; open/closed is a string, positions may be numeric percent.
returns.name: value

read_devices.description: Documentary bearer request for deviceURL, label, controllable and current states; no generic cover resolver is implied.

returns.description: Named State records, including core:OpenClosedState when supported.
returns.name: states

read_setup.description: Documentary bearer request for the complete installation at startup and listener recovery.

register_listener.description: Documentary bearer listener registration; a dedicated lifecycle handler retains the returned id.

unregister_listener.description: Documentary bearer listener cleanup; expiry/reboot still requires dedicated recovery.

txt_match.description: PIN used to construct the HTTPS hostname and bind TLS identity.

methods.notes: Use TXT gateway_pin as identity. Construct gateway-<pin>.local:8443 and require it to agree with the resolved hostname; service and hostname alone are not reliable PIN evidence. GET apiVersion without a token to check the API, then require Bearer owner token on every other call.

mdns_txt_match.description: Authoritative developer-mode gateway identity; never infer the PIN from service/instance name.
Official TXT API version; fw_version is informational and does not select another API root.

identification.notes: Require the TXT gateway_pin to agree with gateway-<pin>.local before HTTPS; use that hostname for the request, never a discovered IP substitute.

tls.notes: Validate against the published Overkiz Root CA at https://ca.overkiz.com/overkiz-root-ca-2048.crt and verify the gateway-<pin>.local hostname. Do not disable verification or substitute an IP request host/SNI; the PIN-derived hostname is required for TLS identity.

device.name: Somfy TaHoma Developer Mode Gateway
device.notes:
SCOPE: TaHoma gateways explicitly supported by the official Developer Mode, including TaHoma Switch, after owner activation and token generation. The first-generation square TaHoma/Somfy box and Connectivity Kit are excluded. Do not substitute the app's separate _kizbox._tcp browsing for the official _kizboxdev._tcp developer advertisement.
Integration is identify_only. The generic mobile consumer has no auth_schemes support, vendor-CA handler, advanced network-action gate, DELETE transport, or resolver for named State records inside a device. All OpenAPI operations and documentary commands below are implementation facts, not a claim that the current generic app can execute them. A dedicated handler must supply those capabilities and attended advanced-write confirmation before supported status can be restored. No generic cover entity, state mapping or DELETE cancellation binding is declared.

openness.notes: Official local API for third-party clients; no private protocol was reverse engineered. Offline activation is not claimed.

enter_pairing_mode.notes: The owner enables Developer Mode with the seven-tap PIN gesture and generates a token in the app; no physical link-button exchange exists in this API.

exclusivity.recovery: Multiple tokens/clients may coexist. Re-read setup once at startup and share/rate-limit event listeners rather than opening a poll storm.

pairing.notes: All endpoints except apiVersion require the owner bearer token. TLS root validation and TXT-PIN matching are separate from bearer authorization; disabling certificate verification is never an accepted pairing shortcut.

pin.notes: The owner generates a bearer token in Developer Mode; gateway_pin is identity, not a password or bearer secret.

unpair.clears: The OpenAPI has no token revoke/delete endpoint. App-side token deletion/revocation was not established; do not claim a factory reset is required or sufficient.
unpair.notes: Delete the client copy and use the official app for any available token lifecycle operation; no API unpair call is declared.

issued_to_client: Owner-generated Developer Mode bearer token, visible only at creation
credentials.notes: App Wi-Fi provisioning uses Bluetooth according to the installation guide; its passphrase wire protection was not established. Local API requests are HTTPS with bearer authorization and Overkiz-root validation. Tokens are secrets even though examples here use placeholders.
stored_on_device: Network settings and TaHoma installation/paired products
Developer Mode enablement and owner-generated token verifier/state

factory_reset.description: Consult exact gateway support before clearing it; regenerating a token is not a factory reset.
factory_reset.effect: No official Developer Mode source establishes a physical factory-reset sequence or whether it revokes tokens, forgets paired motors, clears Wi-Fi or preserves the installation. Do not use the seven-tap developer gesture or motor pairing/reset as a gateway factory reset.

cloud.local_alternative: After activation/token creation, every documented local API call stays on the LAN. Offline activation and excluded/unactivated gateway unlock are unproven.
cloud.provider: TaHoma account installation and developer activation

methods.description: Install the supported gateway, activate Developer Mode from its app parameters, generate an owner token and use it directly on local HTTPS thereafter.

owner_token.notes: Bearer token generated by the owner in Developer Mode and copied at creation; it cannot be read back later or inferred from gateway_pin.

methods.name: TaHoma app Developer Mode and owner token

steps.action: Install the supported gateway in TaHoma by Somfy using Ethernet or a secured 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network and the owner's account.
steps.expect: The gateway is online and appears in the app's installation parameters.

steps.action: In Configure installation → box parameters, tap the gateway PIN seven times to enable Developer Mode.
steps.expect: Developer Mode becomes available and _kizboxdev._tcp is advertised with gateway_pin/api_version/fw_version.

steps.action: Generate a token in Developer Mode and copy it immediately into the client's secret store.
steps.expect: A new owner token is saved; it cannot be read back later, though multiple tokens may be generated.

steps.action: Match TXT gateway_pin to gateway-<pin>.local and configure the published Overkiz Root CA without disabling verification.
steps.expect: HTTPS gateway identity validates on port 8443; a PIN/hostname mismatch fails closed.

steps.action: GET apiVersion without authorization, then call /setup with Authorization: Bearer <token>.
steps.expect: protocolVersion is returned unauthenticated and the bearer-authorized setup document enumerates the installation.

setup.notes: A supported gateway must first be installed in the TaHoma app. Developer Mode activation and token generation are owner-authorized app operations; whether activation works completely offline is unproven. Tokens are visible only at creation. No local token-recovery or offline-unlock path is claimed.

rejoin.notes: Use the TaHoma app's network setup for a replacement secured 2.4 GHz network or Ethernet. Developer Mode does not provide a Wi-Fi write API. Existing token survival across network changes is expected only after the same gateway_pin returns; activation/token survival is not guaranteed by a reset.

steps.action: Change network through the official app, then rediscover _kizboxdev._tcp and require the same gateway_pin.
steps.expect: gateway-<pin>.local resolves again on port 8443; a different PIN is a different gateway, not an address change.

steps.action: Retry the stored owner token only after PIN and Overkiz TLS identity validate; regenerate through the app if rejected.

testing.notes: No supported gateway, owner token, activation, TLS connection or shade was used. Endpoint and lifecycle facts are reported from Somfy-Developer 3eae7a51 and its OpenAPI document. Offline tests use an invented PIN/token, local HTTP stub and no real gateway certificate or device URL.

Root subject/validity/fingerprint recorded; no private key or gateway certificate included.

evidence.documentation_review: Official Developer Mode README 3eae7a51 supplies activation, one-time token display, _kizboxdev._tcp TXT fields, Overkiz root URL, one-second fetch guidance, ten-minute listener lifetime and excluded gateways. Its OpenAPI supplies every declared path, method, body and response shape. TaHoma Switch installation guide supplies secured 2.4 GHz/app setup.
evidence.open_questions: No live gateway was used. Offline activation, app-side token revocation, reset/state survival, per-controllable command support and actual TLS chain presentation on every supported firmware remain unverified.

local_access.summary: The official Developer Mode API supports token-authorized local HTTPS operations; this repository's generic consumer remains identify_only until dedicated handlers exist.

DeviceState.description: State is a named typed record, not a map with uniform value types.

fields.description: Official JSON type code; preserve value rather than coercing everything to string/bool.
fields.name: type

fields.description: open/closed string for core:OpenClosedState; other states may use numeric percent, integer or boolean.
fields.name: value

parse_rules: Find states by name within the device's State array; never assume array position.
A future dedicated cover resolver must match core:OpenClosedState by name and treat missing state as unknown, not closed. No generic state_mapping is declared.
execId is an acknowledgement. Reconcile execution and device events before reporting physical completion.

api.admin_handoff: No device.admin_url is declared: a generic opener would substitute the resolved IP. After the setup step validates TXT PIN, SRV hostname and Overkiz TLS identity, a dedicated client may open https://gateway-<pin>.local:8443/enduser-mobile-web/1/enduserAPI/apiVersion with that same Host/SNI. Do not substitute an unvalidated {gateway_pin} template into the generic admin renderer.
api.authorization: Authorization: Bearer <owner-token> on every endpoint except GET apiVersion, whose security list is empty in the official OpenAPI.
api.content_type: application/json for exec/apply and any body; use normal HTTPS request/response semantics.
api.identity_rule: TXT gateway_pin is authoritative. Require exact case-insensitive agreement with gateway-<pin>.local; reject mismatch rather than guessing from the instance name.
api.request_host: gateway-<gateway_pin>.local; resolve this name or preserve it as Host and TLS SNI. Never replace it with the mDNS IP for certificate validation.

consumer_limits.documentary_boundary: Commands and http_endpoints are a protocol catalogue for a dedicated client. No generic cover entity/state binding or DELETE command is executable today.
missing_handlers: Per-command bearer credentials (no generic auth_schemes consumer)
Overkiz vendor-CA plus PIN-derived Host/SNI verification
Advanced network-action confirmation for attended open/close
Named State array resolution for cover open/closed and optional position/tilt

executions.cancel: DELETE /exec/current/setup/{executionId} for one; DELETE /exec/current/setup for all local setup-level executions.
executions.movement_safety: open/close are advanced and attended. stop/cancel is not advanced. execId acknowledgement means accepted, not physically complete; use events/states and the actual installation.
executions.query: GET /exec/current and /exec/current/{executionId}; these cover only running executions launched through the local API.

listener.fetch: POST /events/{listenerId}/fetch at most once per second; response is an array of Event objects, including device/execution changes.
listener.initial_sync: GET /setup once at application start, then register/fetch events instead of polling setup/devices continuously.
listener.recovery: A listener dies after 10 minutes without fetch and on gateway reboot. On an invalid-listener 400, register a new listener and rebuild event state from /setup; do not silently continue with a dead id.

response_shapes.error: {"error":"<description>","errorCode":"<code>"} on listener fetch 400; preserve for diagnostics without leaking token/PIN.

tls.rule: Add/pin only the published Overkiz root for this gateway context and verify the gateway-<pin>.local hostname. Do not set CERT_NONE, verify_mode none or --insecure; do not substitute the app-bundled Overkiz Device CA without separate evidence.

remaining_unknowns: Whether Developer Mode activation/token generation works with WAN completely offline; no unactivated-gateway unlock is claimed.
App-side token deletion/revocation, factory-reset procedure and token/installation survival across reset or network changes.
Actual certificate chain/hostname details on every supported firmware; clients must still use the published root and never disable verification.
Complete controllable/state/command mappings, including position/tilt units, across the installation's motors and sensors.
Listener invalid-response codes beyond the documented 400 shape and whether every gateway reports reboot expiry identically.
